offer tpl, loyalty level, stock and buy restriction must match the Relationship manifest

integrationState.remainingCrossModuleWork: Economy review is still required for each concrete candidate price/supply envelope; no additional Relationship parser implementation is required before Trader materialization.

tiers.intent: Add bounded navigation, observation, field-maintenance or mission-preparation offers only when they create independent specialist availability and do not unlock combat capability. A finite stock uplift of an already-admitted consumable Baseline offer may be used instead of inventing duplicate merchandise.

Add rarer bounded reconnaissance and expedition-support equipment only when it has independent recurring utility and is not already renewable from vanilla traders. Existing consumable mission-preparation replenishment may increase only inside its authored finite uplift envelope.

Add scarce high-trust logistics or observation equipment only when availability itself is a distinct privilege; do not manufacture a tier reward from duplicate, raw-material or capability-bypass stock. Any Baseline consumable uplift remains finite and price-neutral.

materialization.reason: The frozen 0.1.0 candidate remains exactly 11 offers. Relationship is a post-gate product surface and may remain sparse or empty at a tier until a candidate or bounded existing-consumable stock uplift passes exact gameplay and economy review.
